 Transmission Netherlands Cancels November Festival
 Published
 2 hours ago on
 November 19, 2026 
 By
 Preetika Narula 
 Transmission Netherlands will not take place on November 28 after ticket sales fell short, with organizers now looking at a possible new date
 Transmission Festival has cancelled its upcoming Netherlands edition at GelreDome in Arnhem , days before the November 28, 2026 event. Organizers said ticket sales over recent months had not reached the numbers needed to make the festival financially viable. Unforeseen financial circumstances also contributed to the decision. The team is now discussing possible alternatives with GelreDome , including a new date.
 View this post on Instagram 
 A post shared by TRANSMISSION FESTIVAL (@transmissionfestival) 
 Transmission Netherlands Had a Major Trance Lineup Planned
 Transmission Netherlands planned to run from 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM at GelreDome . Its lineup included Aly & Fila, Andrew Rayel, Daxson, Digital Culture, Driftmoon b2b Asteroid, Markus Schulz b2b Ferry Corsten, Paul van Dyk, XiJaro & Pitch and warm-up DJ Dusk .
 In the days leading up to the announcement, organizers worked closely with GelreDome to find another option. Those discussions are continuing, although the team says it needs more time before confirming what happens next.
 Eventim will send ticket holders further information once organizers settle the next steps. That update will include details about tickets and refunds. Transmission Festival also acknowledged attendees who had already booked travel and accommodation for the weekend.
 With the cancellation coming so close to November 28 , many attendees now have little time to change those plans. Organizers have not announced a replacement date, but they are still considering another solution.
 GelreDome Became Transmission’s Netherlands Home in 2023
 The cancelled event would have continued Transmission Festival’s recent run at GelreDome , which began in 2023. That year, Transmission Elysium Arnhem brought the festival to the stadium for its first Dutch edition there. Transmission The Temple of Time Arnhem followed in 2025.
 The Dutch chapter came after years of international growth for Transmission Festival . The festival first expanded beyond Prague in 2014 and later held editions in Europe, Australia and Asia . Its 10th anniversary at Prague’s O2 Arena drew more than 15,000 people in 2016. Almost 20,000 later attended its first Melbourne stadium edition in 2017.
 For now, the next step depends on whether Transmission Festival and GelreDome can agree on another date. Organizers have not given a timeline and will share more information once those discussions are complete.

 With 13 years in the EDM scene, Preetika has built a strong presence around festivals, club culture, and electronic music. Based in Bangkok, she covers all things EDM in Thailand and beyond, with a focus on both local and international talent. 
She has attended major festivals including Tomorrowland, Ultra Japan, and Creamfields Hong Kong. Since working as a writer for EDM House Network, she has interviewed artists such as Blasterjaxx, James Hype, W&W, R3HAB, Alok, and many others. Her experience and consistent presence in the scene make her a trusted voice for EDM coverage.
